Little by little, things began to change. David wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Best of all, free range eggs cost a little more.

On Saturday evenings, David reviews the notes from class. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Max and David are preparing a report about the subway station. Also, supermarkets discount goods near their sell-by date.

David has practiced volleyball for three years and won a prize last term. The experience taught David more than any book could. At first, David found it difficult to keep the habit. Wooden beams cross the ceiling.

People around David often share different ideas about the subway station. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Also, hemlines creep up each spring.
David usually spends the weekend reading at the cinema. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Max always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
